title: Touchdown
goal: Land safely near the lunar south pole.

touchdown.ridge.title: TOUCHDOWN ON THE RIDGE
touchdown.ridge.text: Contact light! The lander stands on a sunlit ridge where the Sun shines almost all month.

touchdown.craterEdge.title: TOUCHDOWN AT THE CRATER
touchdown.craterEdge.text: Contact light! The lander rests at the edge of a shadowed crater, close to ancient ice.

touchdown.abort.title: ABORT TO ORBIT
touchdown.abort.text: The lander ran too low on fuel to hover, so it fired back up to orbit to try again.
touchdown.abort.lesson: Fuel is time. A gentle descent leaves less hover fuel, so plan your descent with the fuel you really have.

touchdown.crash.title: HARD LANDING
touchdown.crash.text: Blinded by dust, the lander hit a boulder and tipped over. The crew is safe but the base site is lost.
touchdown.crash.lesson: Engine dust can hide the ground. Hover until you can see, or have a plan for when the cameras go blind.
